brief: Photorealistic 16:9 amateur DV still, upstairs room of a modest old Japanese mountain holiday cabin on an overcast late autumn afternoon. Faded warm wood floor and plain aged plaster walls with dark wood framing, a few taped cardboard moving boxes and a folded dust sheet near the right wall, an open sliding doorway in the center leading to a narrow wooden balcony, a small dark brass telescope on a simple three-legged tripod on the balcony. Outside are natural dense cedar trees and a distant low mountain in cool mist. No people, no monster, no writing, no UI, no watermarks. Human eye height from inside the room; broad doorway and telescope clearly readable, restrained desaturated warm-gray palette, believable ordinary modest home rather than luxury architecture, gentle daylight and authentic subtle DV grain. The telescope is small and low, an actual practical instrument, not oversized.
